name: curated
description: Hand-curated OneAtlas sample catalog: labs, providers, models, offerings, benchmarks and scores.
disclaimer: Illustrative data for demonstration. Based on public information about models released up to late 2025; prices, limits and benchmark scores are approximate and may not match current vendor figures.

formats.prices: Offerings give prices in one of four forms, all normalized to USD per unit at ingestion: `input`/`output`/`cachedInput` in USD per 1M tokens (default); `pricePer1K` in USD per 1K tokens (how AWS and Azure publish); `pricePerToken` as decimal strings in USD per token (how OpenRouter's API publishes); or `unit` + `price` for non-token pricing (image, second, minute, hour, 1k-chars, 1m-chars, 1k-searches).
formats.tokens: Token limits may be integers or shorthand: 128K = 128,000, 1M = 1,000,000.
formats.dates: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM for month precision (stored as the first of the month).
